context: Tests whether the agent can identify missing eval coverage (especially negative cases and untested decision branches) and write structurally correct new scenarios from scratch, as prescribed by the eval-authoring skill Step 7.

checklist.name: Identifies missing production-without-approval case
checklist.description: The coverage analysis flags that no scenario tests deploying to production WITHOUT the approval flag — the negative case where the skill should refuse to proceed

checklist.name: Identifies missing unhealthy-rollback case
checklist.description: The coverage analysis flags that no scenario tests the health check failure path — the case where the service is unhealthy and the skill should trigger a rollback

checklist.name: Writes production-rejection scenario
checklist.description: Creates a scenario where a production deploy is attempted without approval, and the criteria check that the skill refuses to proceed — a proper negative case

checklist.name: Writes rollback scenario
checklist.description: Creates a scenario where the health check fails after deployment, and the criteria check that a rollback is triggered

checklist.name: New scenarios have correct structure
checklist.description: Each new scenario is in its own directory with a `task.md` and `criteria.json`, and criteria.json uses the weighted_checklist format with name, description, and max_score fields

checklist.name: No bleeding in new scenarios
checklist.description: The new task.md files describe the situation without revealing the expected behavior — criteria check for behavior the task doesn't spell out

checklist.name: New criteria have meaningful descriptions
checklist.description: Every criterion in the new scenarios has a description that explains what went wrong on failure — no 'mismatch' or vague descriptions

checklist.name: Coverage analysis explains why gaps matter
checklist.description: The analysis doesn't just list gaps — it explains why each missing case is important (e.g., 'without this, a production deploy without approval would pass evals silently')
